quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: The Right Identity
quest.description: Sango from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency seems to have new thoughts about the case she has on hand...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: That seems to be the only possibility...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Hmm... I need to find a few more clues...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the case been going?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Oh-ho, Traveler. You're just in time. We've hit a critical point in our case.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Thanks to Amano and Andou's actions, our culprit seems convinced that the Doushin's investigation is directed towards the Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: So the culprit is still committing crimes in the city from time to time, leaving a lot of tracks behind.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: The culprit committed another crime yesterday. This time, the victim was Mr. Kanbei, the owner of Shimura's.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: After discovering that the money had been stolen from the store, Mr. Kanbei was beside himself with rage — spent some time just yelling angrily outside, so I hear.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: A few years ago, he might have gathered some help and gone to town to search for the thief in person.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: It is a bold move indeed on the culprit's part to steal money from Mr. Kanbei...

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: The timing was quite clever too.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: He noticed that Mr. Kanbei would close his store every few days so he could have a drink.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: So after Mr. Kanbei got drunk, they took the money in the store and strolled out leisurely.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Kanbei has been coming over for several days to ask me to find the culprit. Honestly, I'm getting sick of that loud voice of his.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: As such, I'd like to ask you and Ryuuji to go check out how he's doing and listen to, well, his complaints.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: After that, go ask around if anyone saw or heard anything while the theft was ongoing at Shimura's.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Come back and tell me when you're done. I'll be here waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Hi, what can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I want to ask about the burglary at Shimura's...

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Well, I sure did hear about it. It was hard not to hear Mr. Kanbei's angry voice...

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Wait. Are you asking if I saw anything?

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Sorry, I didn't... In fact, I didn't know about it until I was woken up by the sound of Mr. Kanbei's roaring...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Were there any suspicious people around?

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: Suspicious people? Well... I didn't see anyone suspicious.

dialogues.speaker: Yayoi Nanatsuki
dialogues.text: *sigh* I guess everyone around was woken up because of Mr. Kanbei's loud voice...

dialogues.speaker: Shimura Kanbei
dialogues.text: Darn in... Who on earth would have done this...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you Shimura Kanbei?

dialogues.speaker: Shimura Kanbei
dialogues.text: Ah, yes, I am, and you are... Oh! If it isn't Ryuuji!

dialogues.speaker: Shimura Kanbei
dialogues.text: Has Ms. Sango found out who that monster is? Why, I'm going to whoop that...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: She has not found the culprit yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about the theft...

dialogues.speaker: Shimura Kanbei
dialogues.text: I've told Ms. Sango everything that I know. I drank too much and fell asleep straight away.

dialogues.speaker: Shimura Kanbei
dialogues.text: When I woke up, all the money in the store was gone!

dialogues.speaker: Shimura Kanbei
dialogues.text: Curses... Who would do such a thing...

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is something the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the theft in Shimura's...

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: That? I heard about it.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: If you're looking for a witness, I'm sorry, I don't have any information of value.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: I was busy working at the Adventurers' Guild at the time. I didn't go outside.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: It was only after I heard Mr. Kanbei's shout that I went out to have a look. That's when I heard about the theft.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Was there anyone around who seemed suspicious?

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Suspicious?

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm sorry. I'm afraid wasn't paying close attention to that.

dialogues.speaker: Furuya Noboru
dialogues.text: You should probably ask someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: You're back. How was it? Did you find anything out?

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Well... I see... Thank you. You did a great job.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: This culprit really knows how to pick his targets. Aside from Mr. Kanbei, the owner of Netsuke no Gen Crafts, Mikoshi Genichirou, was also a victim.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: When he left the store to visit his friends, the thief stole a lot of valuable things from within.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ah, right. Miss Yayoi's lacquerware store was also hit. When she went out on a delivery run, a lot of valuable lacquerware was stolen from the store.

choices.text: The thief sure seems familiar with their routines...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: That's right. But as you can see, there aren't many merchants or residents on this street. If a local committed the crime, someone would figure it out.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: But if it wasn't a local, how could the culprit be so precise about when the victims would leave their stores?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: I also thought about that. After Amano and Andou checked the whereabouts of the surrounding households and businesses, the possibility of a local committing the crime has been ruled out.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: The locations of the crime were scattered. It seems like they were done on a whim by Treasure Hoarders roaming into the city...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: But the methods used are so precise. It doesn't look like the Treasure Hoarders did it at all.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: I believe that... perhaps the thief personally scouted out and collected information about the lives of people around the city to make their plans...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: As I said, there aren't many residents here and they all know each other. If there were any strangers, everyone would have noticed.

choices.text: So this is a dead end!

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: So, if the thief could do this, then... he has to have a "suitable persona."

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: It must have been someone who could reasonably show up anywhere at any time without drawing any suspicion.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there really anyone like that?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Of course. In fact, you may have met them already.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: They are...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: People who have experienced a drastic change in personality due to the loss of their Vision.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: How can that be?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Someone who has gone through a drastic personality change due to the loss of Vision. Someone who is drowsy all day, who doesn't know where they were from, and who don't talk to anyone.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Perhaps, to be more convincing and gain sympathy, they might mumble some nonsense to themselves...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: They might even drink alcohol while staring blankly at the roadside...

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Faced with a stranger who has lost their Vision, people would normally feel sympathetic rather than suspicious, right?

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: So, if this stranger was also telling stories about their past... maybe people would be moved to give them Mora. That's how they got the capital to start up this criminal operation.

choices.text: ...To think that someone might use something like that as a cover.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Calm down. To a criminal, society is just a toy to be used to get what they desire.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Thank you for your help. It should only take us a few more steps to find this fellow.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Once I get enough evidence, I'll need your skills again. Until then, go get some rest.

response.speaker: Sango
response.text: Here's your remuneration, by the way.

choices.text: How was the thief so precise in their timing?
